shutdown_request: sudo shutdown -h now returned after SSH connection closed by the remote host
details: A graceful shutdown was requested over SSH to stop compute charges. The SSH session closed and a subsequent connection was refused, but AWS instance state could not be verified. AWS credential checks failed: default and PowerUserAccess SSO sessions were expired and could not refresh; the alternate static-token profile returned InvalidClientTokenId; the remaining profile's STS endpoint was unreachable. Do not infer termination or EBS deletion. Retry AWS-side cleanup after restoring an authorized us-east-1 AWS session.
